summary: Frontend-only testing for Daniel Diaz Sanchez DP portfolio. All 37 test assertions passed across Home hero/categories/project cards, language toggle+persistence, nav, Work filters (all 4 categories have >=1 project), Project detail (title, stills, BTS toggle/grid, external link), About, Contact (email mailto + 4 social links), Admin (wrong password toast, login with ddfilming2026, add/edit/delete project CRUD, export button, logout). Vimeo hero iframe loads with expected Cloudflare Turnstile 401 warnings (user's Vimeo privacy settings, not a bug).
critical_code_review_comments: Admin password is hardcoded in source (contentStore.js) and shown in plaintext footer 'Default password: ddfilming2026'. Acceptable for static-only admin, but note anyone viewing source can find it.
Admin edits persist only in localStorage (per spec) -- users must use Export to persist changes across devices. Consider a clearer UI hint near Save buttons.
VimeoEmbed triggers Cloudflare Turnstile 401 for the configured showreel due to privacy settings; not a code bug but may impact UX. Consider a fallback poster image.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST Project Alpha via admin form and deleted it during test cleanup (localStorage only).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 11 requested flows verified against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Test suite is inline Playwright (not a saved file). Spanish is default (ddp_lang), English toggle works and persists. Admin uses sessionStorage 'ddp_admin_auth'. Project slug 'la-edad-de-la-ira' exists in seeded content.json. Each category (fiction, documentary, commercial, music-video) has at least 1 project.
